com.vector.cfg.consistency.ui

Interface IValidationResultUI

  • All Superinterfaces:
    com.vector.cfg.consistency.contribution.IValidationResultPropertyContext, com.vector.cfg.consistency.ui.IValidationResultUIInternal, IVariantContextInfoUI

    @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value={AUTOMATION_IF,AUTOMATION_IF_INTERNAL_ADDONS})
 @KeepInterfacesSecretFromPublishedApi(value=com.vector.cfg.consistency.ui.IValidationResultUIInternal.class)
public interface IValidationResultUI
extends IVariantContextInfoUI, com.vector.cfg.consistency.contribution.IValidationResultPropertyContext, com.vector.cfg.consistency.ui.IValidationResultUIInternal
    An IValidationResultUI describes an inconsistency in the data model.

    This interface is not intended to be implemented by clients.
    Only the consistency will create IValidationResultUI instances.

      • getSolvingActionByGroupId

        @PublishedMethod
ISolvingActionUI getSolvingActionByGroupId(int id)
        A so called solving-action-group-ID identifies a solving-action uniquely within one validation-result. In other words, two solving-actions, which do semantically the same, from two validation-results of the same result-ID (origin + number), belong to the same solving-action-group. This semantical group may have an optional solving-action-group-ID, that can be used for solving-action identification within one validation-result.

        Keep in mind that the solving-action-group-ID is only unique within one validation-result-ID, and that the group-ID assignment is optional for a validator implementation.

        In order to find out the solving-action-group-IDs, press CTRL+SHIFT+F9 with a selected validation-result to copy detailed information about that result including solving-action-group-IDs (if assigned) to the clipboard.

        If group-IDs are assigned, it is much safer to use these for solving-action identification than description-text matching, because a description-text may change.

        Parameters:
        id - the id
        Returns:
        the solving action by group id or null

      • isResultValidInModelView

        @PublishedMethod
default boolean isResultValidInModelView(IModelView modelView)
        This method checks if this result is valid in the model view. The model view will match, if the following condition is true: 
         
   IValidationResultUI.isGeneralVariantContext() ||
   IValidationResultUI.getPredefinedVariantContexts().contains(theView)
        Parameters:
        modelView - the modelView to check
        Returns:
        true, if the passed model object is valid in the model view

      • matchErroneousCE

        @PublishedMethod
default boolean matchErroneousCE(IViewedModelObject object)
        This method checks if this result annotates the passed CE including a model view. The CE will match, if the following condition is true: 
         IValidationResultUI.matchErroneousCE(theObject) &&
 (
   IValidationResultUI.isGeneralVariantContext() ||
   IValidationResultUI.getPredefinedVariantContexts().contains(theView)
 )
        Parameters:
        object - the object
        Returns:
        true, if the passed model object is annotated by this validation-result

        @PublishedMethod

        @PublishedMethod
void setAcknowledgement(@Nullable

        Sets/removes an acknowledgement for the IValidationResultUI. If the comment is not null, the acknowledgement will be set, otherwise it will be removed.
